profile.headline: Principal Software Engineer at Workday Inc.
profile.summary:
• Highly proficient IT Professional with ten years of Software Development experience.
• Leader and team player with strong interpersonal and communicational skills.
• Played several roles in Software Development life cycle, from Development to Quality Control.
• Quick learner skilled in problem solving and getting things done.

Specialties: Proficient in Java/J2EE development and open source J2EE technologies. Hands-on experience in Servlets, JSP, Fitnesse, Fit, HTML, CSS, Javascript, Spring Framework, EJBs, Hibernate, Guice, JUnit, JavaBeans, JDBC, MySQL, Oracle, PostgreSQL, J2ME, Tomcat, IBM-WebSphere, Python and Linux.

positions.title: QA Engineer
positions.description: Responsible for designing and executing testing strategies for the monetizing framework that converts ad clicks into payments for Google for all revenue drivers.

positions.title: J2EE Developer
positions.description: Development of common components for leader in aviation intelligence (OAG) to display itineraries and travel information to the customer and the internal users.

positions.title: J2EE Developer
positions.description: Development and maintenance of web applications.

positions.title: J2EE Developer
positions.description: Development for Card Applications Team following the ISO 8583 Standard Financial Transactions Card Messages Specification for a variety of large corporate clients.
